# SCP-082 "Fernand the Cannibal"
This guide explains what the object is within the game and how its mechanics work. It does NOT cover the object's lore.
This page contains links to other, more detailed guides about the object, along with a brief description of each section.
## Start of the Round
At the start of the round or after spawning, SCP-082 is located in its containment chamber. The containment chamber is a security measure that prevents the object from harming facility personnel.
While the object remains inside, it poses almost no threat.
- The facility personnel's task is to keep the object inside its containment chamber. - SCP-082's task is to interact with other players through roleplay.
[textlink="More about containment" link="Scp082Containment"]
[textlink="More about escape methods" link="Scp082ContainmentBreach"]
## Abilities
Fernand possesses extraordinary strength and health. These and other traits can help him escape from his containment chamber.
